About this document

This document consolidates three deliverables that are normally maintained separately. They are bound together because the launch decision depends on all three: what the product must do (PRD), how the system is built and operated (TAD), and the testable behaviour expected of each feature (FRD). The appendix contains the integration go-live checklist.

ProductGoods.ng — multi-vendor marketplace for Nigeria
OwnerProduct & Engineering, Goods.ng
AudienceFounders, product, engineering, QA, security, operations, compliance, and integration partners
Source of truthRepository docs/, application code, migrations and automated tests as of 8 November 2026
Verification baseline205 backend tests, 5 frontend unit tests, 6 Playwright E2E scenarios, ruff/eslint/tsc clean, production build passing
Change controlAny change to scope, architecture or an external provider requires a version bump and a launch-gate review

Status vocabulary used throughout

BadgeMeaning
LIVEImplemented in code and covered by automated tests; runs against mock or local infrastructure in development.
CONFIGImplemented, but production requires credentials, a commercial account, DNS, or a provider dashboard step before it is live.
MOCKOnly a mock adapter exists. A licensed partner adapter and contract are required before live use.
NOT BUILTNo implementation yet; required or recommended for launch.
OPTIONALNot required for first launch; planned for growth or scale.
Important launch caveat
Goods.ng does not hold customer funds. Protected Checkout and Goods Flex currently run against mock escrow and mock lending partners. Production boot explicitly refuses mock financial providers. The product must not be described as holding funds or lending until licensed partner adapters are signed, implemented and certified.
